due_when.clears_when: A Tier-2 lane dispatched with 'landing self' can land without a manual hold: either docs/claude/work/approvals/ exists on main with a record per authorized lane, or the dispatch prompt no longer promises self-landing for Tier-2.

origin.ref: session_01JQGnLVnR3UiY1w42hAX6nv, lane FRONTIER-LEVER-TRAINER-DEPS, PR #17682 guards run 38210778886 and local check_pr_landing.py
origin.rerun: python3 scripts/ci/check_pr_landing.py --base origin/main on any Tier-2 landing:self declaration; and ls docs/claude/work/approvals

what: Manager lane dispatches say 'landing self under this authorization' for Tier-2 work, but pr-landing-guard R15(a) refuses Tier-2 landing:self unless .github/pr-landing/<slug>.json names an approved_by record ALREADY ON main (docs/claude/work/approvals/<slug>.json) -- and that directory does not exist on main. Measured on FRONTIER-LEVER-TRAINER-DEPS (PR #17682): guard failed, the lane had to switch to landing:hold and wait ~2h for a manager merge. Fix: the manager commits an approvals record to main at dispatch time for each Tier-2 lane it authorizes (or the dispatch template stops promising self-landing for Tier-2).
